violation_type.title: Required Admission Information-Child's allergies and Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(15))
violation_type.short_title: Required Admission Information-Child's allergies and Completed Food Allergy Plan
violation_type.typical_finding: The standard is evaluated for a standard investigation and is not compliant. The operation does not have a complete food allergy plan for a child with a diagnosis food allergy.

finding_variants.text: The standard is evaluated for a standard investigation and is not compliant. The operation does not have a complete food allergy plan for a child with a diagnosis food allergy.
One child with a food allergy written by the parent did not have a food allergy emergency plan on file.
Two children with diagnosis food allergies did not have a complete F.A.R.E./emergency allergy plan from a health care professional on file.
One of the eight children's files reviewed documented that the child had diagnosed food allergies, but there was no allergy action plan available.
One child with a diagnosed food allergy reported in admission form did not have a food allergy plan at time of inspection.
While checking records, one school aged  child's record did not have a parental permission form completed.
